THE KAZAR STANDARD

The KAZAR Standard

Eight stages connect the brief, technical decisions and construction delivery. These describe the operating system; project records support only the claims they document.

Arrange a project discussion.
THE KAZAR STANDARD / 01—08
01DEFINEBrief & Project Diagnostic+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Establish the brief, current position and the scope of review.

WHY IT MATTERS

Decisions start with the information available.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Agreed brief; Diagnostic scope; assessment record.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

02RESOLVEDesign & Technical Review+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Review construction questions and interfaces within the agreed appointment.

WHY IT MATTERS

Technical questions become visible before execution.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Review comments; RFI; coordinated drawing revision.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

03COORDINATEOne Coordinated Project+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Coordinate responsibilities, interfaces and the sequence of work.

WHY IT MATTERS

Connected trades work to a coordinated sequence.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Coordination minutes; interface register; drawing revision.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

Project-specific evidence is withheld pending publication permission.

04CONTROLCost, Programme & Procurement+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Maintain the agreed scope, programme, procurement and change records.

WHY IT MATTERS

Decisions have an identified commercial and programme context.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Programme; procurement tracker; change record.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

05APPROVESamples, Mock-ups & Benchmarks+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Coordinate samples, mock-ups and acceptance benchmarks.

WHY IT MATTERS

Key details are assessed before repeated installation.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Sample approval; signed benchmark; mock-up record.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

06BUILDControlled Execution+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Deliver the appointed scope against coordinated information and agreed controls.

WHY IT MATTERS

Construction can be checked against recorded decisions.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Dated site record; before-close inspection; progress record.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

07VERIFYTesting & Final Inspection+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Coordinate testing, inspection and close-out within the appointment.

WHY IT MATTERS

Results can be checked against defined criteria.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Test record; inspection result; snag closure record.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.

08HANDOVER & CAREProject Dossier + Aftercare+

WHAT KAZAR DOES

Transfer the agreed project records and organise agreed aftercare.

WHY IT MATTERS

Project information remains accessible after handover.

TYPICAL EVIDENCE

Dossier index; handover record; agreed aftercare terms.

REAL PROJECT RECORD

No public project record attached to this stage.
